photos.author: Suicasmo
photos.scope: Primary daytime front and southern return; current doors/signage, corner columns, roof caps and material appearance. People, lamps and planting obscure lower sections.

photos.author: Ferox Seneca
photos.scope: Opposite oblique front and northern side; confirms domed roof depth/urn ridge, small side attic lights and upper northern return. Lower side obscured by tree.
